ambiguities.description: LineGridScene at column 55 is a separately drawn arrow target without its own explicit containment branches. Baseline includes a standalone root; omitting that isolated reference-only target is an accepted alternative. It must never become part of the MappingDocument label or its containment child.

GridContent is separately drawn at column 57; its first branch starts at column 60, others at 59. Despite the one-column wobble, id/ascii/revision/mappings are its children, sourceRanges is under mappings, and the two range fields are under sourceRanges. This relationship is clear; no unresolved parent alternative is accepted.

The two standalone --> lines indicate save workflow results. Baseline excludes them as reference annotations with no containment edges. A representation retaining them as non-containment annotation records is equivalent.

Legend is an underlined section heading. Baseline excludes heading and includes two connector entries as roots under the explicit-connector appendix policy. Treating Legend as a root parent is an accepted intent alternative; dropping the connector entries entirely is not the declared appendix policy.
